notes.title: Bow hunting: from deer to fish
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pLTZ46AoO7E;full][/previewyoutube]

Equipped with a trusty bow and arrow, the player sets out to hunt deer in the lush forests before turning their attention to the serene waters to catch some fish. Watch as the player's hunting skills are put to the test in this exciting gameplay footage. Get ready to experience the thrill of the hunt like never before!

notes.title: Survival Skills: Efficient Tree Cutting and Wood Extraction System
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=zVFLF2riZo4;full][/previewyoutube]

In this survival gameplay video, we demonstrate how to extract wood from trees using an efficient cutting system. The player approaches the tree and demonstrates their woodcutting skills, showing the tree falling under gravity and breaking into multiple pieces for easy extraction. We showcase techniques such as timber harvesting, tree felling, and wood processing, which are essential survival skills in the wilderness.
